# Company Formation in Dubai

> A practical guide to starting a business in Dubai: choosing between mainland, free zone, and offshore structures, what registration actually costs, and what to sort out afterwards (banking, payments, taxation). Digital partner of a licensed local brokerage — see the site footer for the specific partner and license number.

## Pages

- [Overview](https://llc.dst.llc/): How to choose between mainland, free zone, and offshore, and what actually drives the decision.
- [Zones](https://llc.dst.llc/zones/): Specific free zones compared, not a generic list.
- [Banking](https://llc.dst.llc/banking/): Opening a corporate bank account as a new Dubai company — what's actually required.
- [Payments](https://llc.dst.llc/payments/): Payment processing options for a new Dubai entity.
- [Taxation](https://llc.dst.llc/taxation/): Corporate tax and VAT basics for a new UAE company.
- [News](https://llc.dst.llc/news/): Regulatory changes and updates to this site's own guidance.
- [Events](https://llc.dst.llc/events/): Sessions on Dubai company formation, when there are any scheduled.

## News & events feed

Short, first-party items only — an empty feed at any time means there's nothing to report yet, not a missing page. Sources are named in the article text ("Source: X"), never linked as a live URL; the one exception is an event's ticket/registration link, which routes through /go/<slug>/ (noindex, nofollow) rather than linking out directly.

Part of the [DST](https://dst.llc/) network.
